findings.reason: node 3's selection must name missing hashes (or the re-embed and the census must share one predicate), else the section re-embeds nothing and its own census can never pass.
findings.text: the third node re-embeds "every FacilitySignal whose stored hash differs from the hash of its current text" (line 282) while the done-when (line 287) says "A missing hash counts as a mismatch"; under Cypher `s.embedded_text_hash <> $h` is null for a null property, so a filter written as "differs" selects no null-hash rows — the exact rows the census fails on, and on the first run every pre-existing node's hash is missing

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `GraphClient.create_nodes` (imas_codex/graph/client.py:605), `imas_codex/discovery/signals/`, §1's cosine probe (plan line 75) and §3's rule and harness all resolve.

rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the measurement and the census are placed in `docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/embeddings.html`, a durable in-repo path beside the fragments §3 and §4 already write.

rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5's third node re-embeds "every FacilitySignal whose stored hash differs from the hash of its current text", but the section's own done-when treats a missing hash as a mismatch; the two predicates select different row sets and the re-embed will skip the rows the census fails on.
